title: Do historical SSI pathogen profiles identify later infection depth and resistance patterns?
recommended_role: Supplementary microbiology context; exploratory source-profile grouping
status: Descriptive compositional separation is stable; no independent outcome passes four-outcome BH adjustment.

units.depth: SSI pathogen reports assigned to infection depth
units.resistance: Published MRSA percentage among tested Staphylococcus aureus reports

model.compositional_transform: Centered log ratio of eight stable explicit taxa and the exact remaining-taxa total, half-count pseudocount 0.5
model.clustering: Unweighted profile kmeans, three centers, seed 20261020, 1000 starts
model.choice_of_three_groups: Highest discovery mean silhouette among k=2,3,4; exploratory selection in only ten discovery profiles
model.pca: PCA fit on discovery profiles only; later profiles use fixed centering and loadings
model.pseudocount_sensitivity: Every profile retains its assigned group with pseudocount 0.25, 0.5, or 1.0

primary_outcome_family.test: Exact age-blocked profile permutation, partial-F statistic
Exact age-blocked profile permutation, partial-F statistic
Exact age-blocked profile permutation, partial-F statistic
Exact age-blocked profile permutation, partial-F statistic

a.encoding: PC1 and PC2 coordinates; color source profile group; distinct marker for discovery and later profiles; hull is descriptive envelope of all displayed aggregate points
a.statistics: Report discovery silhouette and variance explained. Do not test groups against their defining taxa.

b.raw_points: profile_depth_counts_long.csv joined to profile_metadata.csv and frozen group labels
b.encoding: Grouped bars for all three SSI depths, source profile means with profile bootstrap intervals; show n=3,8,2 later profiles
b.statistics: Age-blocked exact source-profile permutation with age-adjusted partial-F statistic; BH family contains all three depths and conditional MRSA. Label P and q together.
b.warning: The intervals summarize profile resampling, not patient-level or hospital-cluster uncertainty. The two-profile group has limited precision.

c.encoding: Nine composition components by three frozen groups, later source-report shares as percentages; add each group denominator 117382,102349,1220
c.statistics: Descriptive only because these taxa define the groups.

d.encoding: Box or range with every actual source-profile MRSA percentage shown as a point; n=2,7,2
d.statistics: Exact age-blocked source-profile permutation P=0.0357143; four-outcome BH q=0.1428571; nominal result does not survive adjustment
d.warning: Published percentages are rounded and denominators tested are not exact. Do not compute Fisher tests or binomial intervals from compatible counts.

scientific_boundaries: The third group contains pediatric cardiac and neurosurgical profiles only; its label and interpretation must retain pediatric context.
Group definition and PCA discovery sample are small and source profiles can share hospitals; permutation exchangeability is an exploratory ecological modeling assumption.
All four later outcome tests are disclosed. The adjusted findings are null.
National profiles remain separate from California operations. No national organism is assigned to a California procedure record.
Other procedures is an exact residual source category whose procedure mixture changes across age and report periods.
The remaining-taxa component includes organisms without exact complete availability across every published procedure profile; no unreported explicit taxa were imputed as zero.
Taxonomic regrouping of Enterobacter and selected Klebsiella is handled by excluding them as separate common features.
The source total contains 330914 SSI events and 378610 pathogen reports. These are separate denominators, and national totals must not be added to overlapping California surveillance totals.
